caption: The drawing features a wooden chair with four prominent, turned legs and three horizontal slats that form the backrest. The frame of the chair is brown with a polished wood appearance. The seat of the chair is square and appears to be woven in a checkerboard pattern using two alternating colors: a light green and a white or off-white, creating a tightly interlaced design. The lower section of the chair has additional horizontal wooden supports connecting the legs for added stability. Beneath the image, the text "Childs Tilting Chair" is written in a thin, gray font. The background is a plain, light beige color with some faint discolorations, and there are a few additional handwritten notes in the lower right and lower left corners. Shadows can be seen beneath the chair, contributing to the sense of depth in the drawing.
title: Shaker Three Slat Titlting Chair
